title: Mexican Sweet Potato Fajitas
description: A flavorful and comforting Mexican-inspired dish featuring sweet potatoes, bell peppers, onions, and your favorite toppings.

ingredients.name: Optional: avocado, sour cream, shredded cheese, cilantro, salsa

instructions: Preheat a large skillet to medium-high heat.
Peel and slice the sweet potatoes into 1/2-inch thick rounds.
Add the olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat.
Add the sliced sweet potatoes to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, or until they start to brown.
Add the sliced bell peppers and onions to the skillet and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Sprinkle the fajita seasoning over the vegetables and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together.
Serve the fajita mixture hot, topped with your favorite toppings, if desired.
